premise: Around 1000, at a fictional monastery in southern England. A village disputes its winter grain obligation. Investigate through manuscripts, witnesses and the delivery route; restrained, ambiguous folk horror.

history.scope: Opened 2026-09-06: 700-1200 England/France manuscript project overview. Supports manuscript culture, not exact village institutions, literacy rates, prices or individual tools. Detailed site content unavailable; all local arrangements and equipment quantities are original allocations.

skills.limit: No new points or bonus dice; occupational eligibility remains in the linked creation specification.

skills.name: Track

items.name: Writing kit
items.acquisition: Optional equipment supplied at the relevant scene by its fictional custodian; not added to starting cards.
items.price_basis: Explicit loan or supply allocation, no purchase or historically asserted price.
items.procedure: Prepare a witnessed handwritten copy after access is granted.
items.effect: Preserves the observed wording for comparison; no bonus die or automatic translation.
items.limits: One kit; ink and writing surface sufficient for three short copies by explicit allocation.
items.upkeep: Mark each copy; after three, request supplies from the custodian.
items.substitute: Ask a literate custodian to read aloud; record oral testimony.

items.name: Measuring cord
items.acquisition: Optional equipment supplied at the relevant scene by its fictional custodian; not added to starting cards.
items.price_basis: Explicit loan or supply allocation, no purchase or historically asserted price.
items.procedure: Lay beside visible wheel impressions with the guide.
items.effect: Compare widths at two locations; agreement is supporting evidence, not proof of identity.
items.limits: One cord, no climbing or load-bearing rating supplied.
items.upkeep: Dry and return it; if lost, use counted paces with lower precision.
items.substitute: Compare the route with a local cart driver.

items.name: Host introduction token
items.acquisition: Optional equipment supplied at the relevant scene by its fictional custodian; not added to starting cards.
items.price_basis: Explicit loan or supply allocation, no purchase or historically asserted price.
items.procedure: Present the fictional steward's marked token to request a hearing.
items.effect: Establishes who sent the party; the recipient still decides access.
items.limits: One loaned token, no universal legal or religious authority.
items.upkeep: Return at departure; loss can be explained by the steward in person.

scenes.title: Cold archive
scenes.entry: Wet stone and an empty space between stitched leaves. Reach it through the preceding lead; the first scene is the agreed starting appointment.
scenes.exit_condition: Follow the next lead or leave with an explicitly incomplete report at the final scene.
scenes.npc: Sister Maud wants the archive intact; she will supervise reading but refuses removing originals.
scenes.objects: Binding holes, surviving dates, a copied tally.
scenes.clue: The missing leaf concerns a delivery at the lower ford, not an accusation of witchcraft.
scenes.pressure: Original shared delay counter starts at 0. Each failed specialist attempt or ordinary route adds 1; at the first total of 3 the primary NPC leaves. The named ordinary-route contact stays available. Further delays do not remove that contact. No automatic HP/SAN loss.

routes.cost: One investigative attempt; on failure add one delay and use a different route or meet native-system retry conditions.
routes.outcome: Success: The missing leaf concerns a delivery at the lower ford, not an accusation of witchcraft. Failure: A failed reading leaves the date uncertain; Maud can name the ford from her own account.

routes.method: Negotiate the specific cooperation described in the NPC entry.
routes.cost: An interview and an offered favor; decline or failed persuasion leaves the ordinary route available.
routes.outcome: Success gains a more precise account with permission; failure withholds that cooperation, not every onward lead.

routes.method: At the public bell, lay attendant Ead orally repeats the delivery destination: the lower ford. Ead remains available even when Maud leaves; this identifies the place without proving the missing wording.
routes.cost: One delay; no special equipment or successful skill roll. Accept less precise evidence and the stated access limits.
routes.outcome: After a failed specialized attempt, take this separate limited lead and pay the ordinary delay. scenes.title: Lower ford
scenes.entry: Deep wheel tracks disappear into reeds. Reach it through the preceding lead; the first scene is the agreed starting appointment.
scenes.exit_condition: Follow the next lead or leave with an explicitly incomplete report at the final scene.
scenes.npc: Carter Oswin wants payment and fears blame; he offers his route in exchange for help identifying the disputed load.
scenes.objects: Wheel impressions, spilled grain, a repaired gate.
scenes.clue: A second cart diverted part of the load toward the petition house.
scenes.pressure: Original shared delay counter starts at 0. Each failed specialist attempt or ordinary route adds 1; at the first total of 3 the primary NPC leaves. The named ordinary-route contact stays available. Further delays do not remove that contact. No automatic HP/SAN loss.

routes.method: Compare tracks and travel direction without claiming a unique match.
routes.cost: One investigative attempt; on failure add one delay and use a different route or meet native-system retry conditions.
routes.outcome: Success: A second cart diverted part of the load toward the petition house. Failure: Rain destroys fine marks after failure; Oswin can describe the petition-house delivery, without identifying the second driver.

routes.method: Negotiate the specific cooperation described in the NPC entry.
routes.cost: An interview and an offered favor; decline or failed persuasion leaves the ordinary route available.
routes.outcome: Success gains a more precise account with permission; failure withholds that cooperation, not every onward lead.

routes.method: At the ford gate, cart-minder Wyn describes a delivery to the petition house. Wyn stays on duty after Oswin leaves; the account names no second driver and requires no track identification.
routes.cost: One delay; no special equipment or successful skill roll. Accept less precise evidence and the stated access limits.
routes.outcome: After a failed specialized attempt, take this separate limited lead and pay the ordinary delay. At the ford gate, cart-minder Wyn describes a delivery to the petition house. Wyn stays on duty after Oswin leaves; the account names no second driver and requires no track identification.

scenes.title: Petition house
scenes.purpose: Decide how to present a disputed obligation.
scenes.entry: A household recites a different count beside an unlit hearth. Reach it through the preceding lead; the first scene is the agreed starting appointment.
scenes.exit_condition: Follow the next lead or leave with an explicitly incomplete report at the final scene.
scenes.npc: Steward Aelf wants an orderly settlement; a tenant asks that names be heard privately.
scenes.objects: Witness list, public tally, seal impression.
scenes.clue: The witnesses distinguish a changed obligation from an accounting error; motives remain open to interpretation.
scenes.pressure: Original shared delay counter starts at 0. Each failed specialist attempt or ordinary route adds 1; at the first total of 3 the primary NPC leaves. The named ordinary-route contact stays available. Further delays do not remove that contact. No automatic HP/SAN loss.

routes.method: Locate the matching public tally at an invited hearing.
routes.cost: One investigative attempt; on failure add one delay and use a different route or meet native-system retry conditions.
routes.outcome: Success: The witnesses distinguish a changed obligation from an accounting error; motives remain open to interpretation. Failure: Failure means the original tally is withheld; a public oral petition still records the discrepancy, but cannot prove the exact wording.

routes.outcome: Success gains a more precise account with permission; failure withholds that cooperation, not every onward lead.
